translations: (for) His slave And they threaten you with those
besides Him besides Him And whoever
Allah lets go astray  Allah lets go astray
puzzle.hint: A powerful declaration that Allah alone is sufficient for the believer, and no worldly threat or false guide can harm one whom Allah protects.
puzzle.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ
puzzle.verseEn: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
